briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion and DeepSeek R2 escalate AGI compute arms race amid US export curbs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race to deploy next-gen models while regulators scramble to address security gaps. Compute shortages and talent poaching intensify between US and Chinese players. DialectForge emerges as a protocol-level solution for multi-agent security.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases Orion-1 with 4T parameters; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 3 Ultra internally. Meta open-sources Llama 4.1 while xAI ships Grok-3 to select partners.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for automotive, IoT, and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for NVIDIA Blackwell; Microsoft announces $40B Texas AI campus. Saudi Arabia commits $25B to sovereign AI cluster with Cerebras.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls on advanced chips slow China's AGI timeline more than they accelerate domestic alternatives?
